Game Overview

In Crab & Fish, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the aquatic realm of Crab & Fish, where you guide a daring crab through physics-based puzzles to free captured fish. Break blocks strategically to help the crab descend and liberate his friends, all while maintaining balance to avoid a tower-toppling fate.

How to Play

Getting started in Crab & Fish doesn't take long to learn. Dive into the aquatic realm of Crab & Fish, where you guide a daring crab through physics-based puzzles to free captured fish.
